name: intrepid-spearman-combat-damage-reveal-wind-prevent
notes: Effects Stack fixture-coverage gap fill: dealDamageAbilities["pal7cpvn96:0"] (GeneratedCode/GeneratedMacroCode.php) is itself an intentional no-op stub -- the real logic is a synchronous replacement effect inlined in OnDealDamage() (CombatLogic.php), guarded by DecisionQueueController::GetVariable("CombatAttacker") !== null, so it only applies to real combat damage. No prior fixture dealt real combat damage to this card. P2's champion (with a 1-POWER weapon) attacks P1's Intrepid Spearman directly (GetValidAttackTargets() allows attacking an opposing ALLY, not just the champion); the champion is patched to Level 1+ via a level counter, and the sole memory card is WIND element for a deterministic array_rand() reveal.

rulesClauses: [Level 1+] If combat damage would be dealt to Intrepid Spearman, reveal a card at random from your memory.
If that card is wind element, prevent 3 of that damage.
Apply this replacement effect only once per turn.
